QuestInfo.name: Find the Maple History Book 2
QuestInfo.1: I found all 3 Maple History Books, and gave them all to #p2041022#. He gave me #t4031160# and told me to go see #b#p1012109##k.
QuestInfo.2: I showed #p1012109# the #t4031160# that Tigun gave me, and in return, he gave me #t1012109:#. As a sign of thanks for finding the history book, #p1012109# gave me #t1012109:#.

0.0: Thank you for coming back. I was unable to award you #t4031160# last time; I've been very busy, you know. But now that I have a chance again, will you accept this as a sign of our hearts?

yes.0: #r#t4031160##k looks really nice on you Go back to #bHensesys#k and show it to #b#p1012109##k to prove that the #bMaple History Books#k are well on its way to Ludibrium. For that, you may be able to get something nice in return, so go see that person.

no.0: By the way, #t4031160# is for you. Please accept this, for this is my way of saying Thank You for your hard work.

1.0: Are you back already? Did you get the #bMaple History Books#k sent? Did you receive a #b#t4031160##k from #b#p2041022##k??

yes.0: Oh, wow. Thank you so much! I can't believe how excited I'm to hand the book over to the King of Ludibrium. Hmmm, what would be a perfect gift for my friend? Ah, here's a hat my dad used to wear during his traveling days. It may be old and used, but it's very valuable nonetheless. Try it on!

item.0: If you have completely taken care of all the requirements for this, then you would have gotten #t4031160# from #p2041022#...but you'll have to show me...
